notes.title: Bug Fixes for May 13, 2025
notes.content:
Fixes:

1. Fixed issues with lighting effects being out of sync during boss fights.
2. Fixed Thokk's minions being spawned after he dies in boss rush mode.

Performance:

1. I disabled most of the lighting effects in the game :( 
It looked cool but unfortunately was very expensive in terms of performance. 
2. I optimized boss rush mode a bit.
